items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: We had the, Sharniowski come on and rehearse the band.

ctx.x: Would you go around to the night club?

No. No. No. The white artists have always just been used to do since I brought to all the talent. They never did. In the old days, we were much more interested in the band. But now we're just going seven nights a week. It was very important that we had a good band. The band rehearsed regularly. Even Bates band. We had the, Sharniowski come on and rehearse the band. The fellow who was a singer for so many years. We had a stage band. He was a singer. And he was a lesson. And he went out to the Chicago theater. He…
What about Dewey Jackson? Do you remember him? Yeah, he played on the road.
